summary: Telegram bot library with keyword-only static matches; no traced installer harm
details: node-telegram-sockets is a Telegram Bot API client library. Static keyword matches fired on co-occurrence of 'ping' (consistent with Telegram's getMe/health-check methods or test fixtures) in lib/telegram.js, src/telegram.js, and test/telegram.js, and on the combination of fs.readFileSync + require('http')/require('https') in lib/telegramWebHook.js and src/telegramWebHook.js (consistent with reading TLS certificate/key files to start an HTTPS webhook listener, which is the documented Telegram webhook pattern). No hardcoded non-Telegram attacker endpoint, no env-var scraping, no credential-path reads (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), no lifecycle hook fetching remote code, and no install/import-time exfiltration mechanism are present in the cited evidence. The pattern matches are keyword co-occurrences without a traced data-to-destination flow, so installer-side harm cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
